name: Custom 404 Boundary Breach Verification
description: Verifies that navigating to an unrecognized route displays the custom 404 Boundary Breach page and allows returning to cockpit.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the unrecognized perimeter path at /unknown-perimeter-boundary
Verify that the page displays '404 // Boundary Breach' and 'Perimeter Breach: Path Undefined'
Verify that the button 'Return to Security Cockpit' is visible and clickable
Click the 'Return to Security Cockpit' button
Verify that navigation returns to the root cockpit showing the ShipSafe header and submission panel
